extracted.name: Yellow Rice for Rice Cookers
extracted.description: Use this recipe for yellow rice made in a rice cooker as a base for adding vegetables or meat for a flavorful and easy side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 (.18 ounce) packets sazon seasoning with annatto
instruction_lines: Place chicken stock, rice, tomato sauce, olive oil, salt, sazon seasoning, garlic powder, and chicken bouillon in the rice cooker; stir to combine. Cover and cook according to manufacturers' instructions for one cycle until rice is tender and fluffy, 20 to 25 minutes.
